name: lispan_f01C_w96
description: Li-SPAN forward PINN, 0.1 C discharge of the Simanjuntak 2024 cell (Z_CC 0.025), 30 s current ramp. Reference: finite-volume model with c_DL -> 0. Reactions 2 and 3 irreversible (benchmark choice: the mass-action reverse term of reaction 2 at high Delta phi slaves c_S2 to an equilibrium that spans 10 decades, a stiff constraint a PINN cannot resolve; the finite-volume reference shows a 2.6 mV rms / 10 mol/m3 effect at 0.1 C and 0.1 mV at 1 C). Run B: width 96, 8 Fourier modes, 20k steps, global salt inventory residual.
